test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following oil fields is located in Assam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Digboi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Digboi** is a renowned oil town located in the northeastern state of **Assam**, India. It is famously known as the **oldest oil refinery in Asia** and one of the oldest functioning refineries in the world.
 
• Oil was first discovered in Digboi in the late **19th century**, specifically in **1867**, by British engineers working on railway construction in the region.
 
• The establishment of the Digboi refinery began in **1901**, and operations started in **1906**. This makes it a historical and industrial landmark in the global oil industry.
 
• Digboi's oil fields have been instrumental in contributing to India’s **petroleum industry**. The refinery continues to process crude oil and manufacture petroleum products.
 
• The town of Digboi is not just an industrial hub but also a tourist attraction, with its colonial heritage, oil museum, and the famous **Digboi War Cemetery**, which commemorates soldiers from World War II.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Key Features of Digboi:**

 
 
• Located in the **Tinsukia district of Assam**, Digboi lies in a region known for its biodiversity and scenic beauty.
 
• The name "Digboi" is said to have originated from the phrase "Dig, boy, dig!" which was reportedly used by the British engineers during their search for oil in the area.
 
• The oil fields of Digboi are part of the extensive **Assam-Arakan Basin**, one of the most significant petroleum-producing regions in India.
 
 
 
• **Other Options Explained:**
 
 
• **Kharsang:** Located in Arunachal Pradesh, not Assam. It is another oil field, but geographically distinct from Digboi.
 
• **Cambay:** Situated in Gujarat, Cambay is a prominent oil field in western India and unrelated to Assam’s oil fields.
 
• **Ravva:** Located in Andhra Pradesh, it is an offshore oil and gas field, far from the northeastern region of India.
 
 
 
• **Historical Significance of Digboi:**
 
 
• Digboi played a crucial role in India’s **industrialization**, particularly in the oil and energy sector.
 
• The Digboi oil refinery is managed by the **Indian Oil Corporation (IOC)**, ensuring its continued operation and modernization.
 
• It serves as a reminder of India’s technological and industrial heritage during British colonial rule.
 
 
 
• **Petroleum Industry in Assam:**
 
 
• Assam is one of the leading states in India for **crude oil production**, accounting for a significant portion of the country’s total output.
 
• Other important oil fields in Assam include **Rudrasagar, Moran, and Naharkatiya**.
 
• The state is also home to natural gas fields and supports several refineries, such as the **Numaligarh Refinery**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **Assam-Arakan Basin** is considered one of India’s oldest and most important sedimentary basins for hydrocarbon exploration.
 
• Digboi’s development marked the beginning of India’s **petroleum industry**, which has since expanded to other regions such as Gujarat, Rajasthan, and offshore fields in the Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal.
 
• Assam’s oil fields are crucial for meeting India’s energy needs and reducing dependence on imported crude oil.
 
• The **Digboi Oil Museum** offers insights into the history of oil exploration in India, showcasing antique equipment and photographs from the early 20th century.
